• A file for every well: what it cost, what it made, whether it ever paid out.
• Barn burners, dusters and dogs. You will have all three.

A CENTURY OF BOOMS AND BUSTS
• Real prices, real history: the gusher age, the boomtowns, a dime a barrel in the Depression, the embargo, the long bust, the shale revolution.
• Thirteen eras, from cable-tool rigs to three-mile laterals.
• Leases on the Arctic coast that nobody wants, and no pipeline for nine years. Seventy-million-dollar wildcats in the deep water of the Gulf. Countries abroad that keep their share and sometimes change their minds.
• And after 2030 the game does not stop. There is always another frontier, and the next one is further out than you think.

A COMPANY WITH A PAYROLL
• Landmen, geologists, tool pushers, bookkeepers: each with a face, a knack and an opinion, and now and then the nerve to voice it.
• Two dozen rival companies with silly names, every one of them after your acreage.
• Thirty-two painted newsreels for the big moments. None is ever forced on you.

A GAME TO LEAVE RUNNING
• Made to sit beside your work: the wells pump, the rig turns, and you look up when one comes in.
• Stops the clock for the big news, or never, as you like.
• Plays on iPhone and iPad, either way up.

ONE PRICE. THAT IS ALL.
No ads. No timers. No gems. No account. No internet needed, and nothing collected: the game makes no network calls at all. The only thing it wants you to buy is more acreage.

The companies in the game are inventions, and any likeness to a real one is parody. The voices are AI-generated.

apps.name: Orbit Duel - DareDoesGames
apps.description:
AIM AROUND THE PLANETS.
No ads. No energy meter. No account. No analytics. No internet. Just gravity.

FEATURES
- Every planet pulls your shot. Curve it, slingshot it, sometimes it comes back.
- Two to eight players: pass one phone, add computer players on Easy, Medium or Hard, or play one phone each nearby with no internet.
- One to five lives each. Each hit costs a life; the last ship flying wins.
- Play 1, 3, 5 or 10 rounds, or keep going.
- Watch shots at 1x, 3x or 5x, or hold the screen to fast forward. Every collision slows down and zooms in.
- Pause any time, on any phone.
- Build your own ship: eight hulls, sixteen paints, four shots and six trails.
- Aim with a joystick wherever your finger lands, then fine-tune.
- Your last shot stays on the field, faint, so you can adjust.

apps.name: Pigeon’s Mission
apps.description:
SAVE MOM & DAD!

One night, a little pigeon named Archie fell asleep. When he woke up, his whole family was gone, snatched by Crazy Guy, a goo-mutated villain with very big plans. Archie can't fly, but he's going anyway.

Pigeon's Mission is a pixel-packed platformer bursting with heart, humor and a whole lot of jumping. Wall-jump, dash and battle your way across seven dreamy worlds, outsmart bosses with backstories, and bring Archie's family home.


IT STARTED WITH A SKETCHBOOK
Logan was six when he walked up to his dad with an idea: he wanted to make his own video game. His dad JUMPED at it. Logan ran to his sketchbook and drew everything: the hero, the enemies, the worlds and the final villain. A small team signed on, and those pencil drawings became the game you're holding. Every character you'll meet started on one of Logan's pages.


TIGHT, SNAPPY, MADE FOR YOUR THUMBS
Wall-slides, midair dashes and combo attacks, with on-screen controls tuned so Archie moves the instant you do. Easy to pick up. Hard to put down.

EVERY SEED IS A CHOICE
Meet the Harvest Pulse System. Golden Seeds power every gadget you carry. Collect them from enemies and hidden corners, then decide: glide over the gap, blast the snail, or save up for something bigger?

SEVEN WHIMSICAL WORLDS
• Hill Hopping: your cozy intro to the adventure
• Dusty Dunes: enemy waves and desert wind puzzles
• Rocky Road: heavy combat and hidden smash paths
• Splashy Streams: underwater puzzles and glowing ruins
• Whacky Woods: carnival chaos meets high-speed coasters
• Heavenly Hike: skyborn combat and floating islands
• Cosmic Craft: the final showdown in a high-tech alien lair

SEVEN QUIRKY GADGETS
Glide with the Winged Wonder. Blast with the Pinecone Launcher. Suck up trouble with the DustBuster. Smash with the Rocky Hammer. Dive with the Hydro Helm. Rise with the Phoenix Feather. Then climb into the Tech Mech power suit for the grand finale.

MEET THE CREW
Archie Airborne: the hero. Can't fly.
Big Bob: the muscle. Also the snacks.
Meg: the heart. And the brains.

BOSSES WITH BIG PERSONALITIES
Big Bug digs, rolls and drops from above. Rocky Ronster throws fire punches over rising lava. The Magnificent Marvo, a magic squirrel, fights with illusions. Then come Ray the Rat, Whirlpool Wave, Flam, Crazy Guy himself, and one more we're keeping secret.


WHY FAMILIES LOVE IT
• Fun for kids, rewarding for seasoned platformer fans
• 4 to 6 hours of story
• No ads. No accounts. No in-app purchases. Ever.
• Plays offline, perfect for road trips and flights
• A real story about a real kid who dreamed big

BACKED AND FEATURED
• Kickstarter Project We Love, funded by 258 backers
• Featured by GameMaker
• Game Devs of Color Expo selection
• OTK Games Expo 2025 Chat Choice Award

Ready? Archie's family is waiting. Let's go!

PigeonsMission.com
A Glowing Cheetah Studios game, Miami, FL.

apps.name: Pudding Racers
apps.description:
Welcome to a kart world made of sugar! In Pudding Racers you zoom through Pudding Park, Lollipop Lagoon, Cotton Candy Fair, Gingerbread Town and the Ice Cream Alps – with drifts, speed and plenty of sugar. And everyone races together: iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple TV in the same race.

EVERYONE RACES TOGETHER
• Crossplay: iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple TV share the same race
• Up to 8 players on the same Wi-Fi network or via Personal Hotspot – no internet needed, just a short room code
• Online races against other players over the internet – with friends, you race together on Wi-Fi with a room code
• Bots fill the grid up to 12 racers, and there’s a Tournament mode too
• Emotes that everyone in the race can see

DRIVE WITH FEEL
• Drift for a Sugar Boost: hold your drift through Pinch and Spoon all the way to Bag, then let go and zoom!
• Bubblegum Start: hit the gas to the beat on 3, 2 and 1 and launch with a Sugar Boost.
• Cotton Candy Draft: stay close behind another kart and get pulled along.
• Stunts: spin in mid-air and land clean for an extra boost.

THE SUGAR JAR
No random item boxes here: your Sugar Jar fills up when you drive well – with Sugar Pearls, drifts, stunts and overtakes. Before the race you pick one of five recipes, from Soda Fountain to Pop Bonbon, and fire it at just the right moment. Everyone fills their jar at the same speed, no matter their position.

SINGLE PLAYER
• Race up to 11 bots across six difficulty levels, from Cozy to Extra Sour
• Treat Tour: several races in a row, with a Cake Podium and a Prize Lollipop
• Time Chase: race your own Glass Ghost and beat the Royal Baker’s time – with a Game Center world leaderboard for the fastest lap on each track
• Three Daily Tasks that change every day, three cherries on every track and 12 badges – which you also collect as Game Center achievements

GARAGE AND RACER
• Build your kart from body, tires, spoiler and engine – the parts change how it handles
• Paint jobs, stickers, antennas, turbo flames and horns for your style
• Five racers, including a gummy bear, a marshmallow bunny and an ice cream penguin – plus hats, glasses, scarves, colors and emotes
• Earn Bonbon Bucks in every race. Racers and accessories are purely cosmetic – on the track, only skill counts.
• Bucks packs are also available as optional In-App Purchases.

ONE PURCHASE FOR ALL YOUR DEVICES
Buy once, race everywhere: Pudding Racers runs on iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple TV. iCloud brings your progress to every device signed in with the same Apple Account – Bucks, unlocked items, records and badges included. You can turn this off in OPTIONS.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Customizable touch controls and game controllers, plus keyboard on iPad
• On Apple TV you need a game controller (tvOS 27 or later)
• Playable offline: single player and Wi-Fi races need no internet
• No ads, no tracking

apps.name: Puffy Garage Spatial
apps.description:
Open the night garage on Apple Vision Pro!

A glowing toy garage appears on your table. Ten cute cars wait in their own bays: Police Car, Fire Truck, Digger, Monster Truck, Race Car, City Car, Off-Roader, Buggy, Ice Cream Van and Camper. Tap a car and it jumps onto the turntable in front of you.

TAP TO PAINT
• Tap any part of your car and paint it: the body, the stripes, the wheels or a part you added
• Spin the car around with your fingers to see every side

40 COOL PARTS
• Sirens, rockets, shark fins, dragon heads, bubble makers, magnets, disco balls, fireworks, rainbow exhaust and more
• Toy, sport and giant monster wheels
• All parts are ready to use, no stars or unlocking needed

PICK A DRIVER
• Ten plush puffs can drive: Teddy, Bunbun, Mochi, Pandy, Ribbit, Puffy, Rexy, Coco, Hamham and Fifi
• Dress them up with racing helmets, police caps, fire helmets, crowns, cowboy hats, shades and goggles

DRIVE!
Your car jumps onto the little road, races two laps around the garage and comes back. Sirens flash, rockets roar and fireworks pop.

BIG CAR!
Tap Big car! and your car appears life-sized on your floor. Walk around it, look inside and keep painting.

MADE FOR LITTLE HANDS
• Just look and tap your fingers
• Big picture buttons, no reading needed
• Cheerful garage music and fun sounds

SAFE AND PRIVATE
• No ads
• No in-app purchases
• No accounts and no internet needed
• Nothing leaves the device

apps.name: Puzzled Puzzler
apps.description:
A frame drops. It lands, and smoke rolls around the whole frame. For ten seconds the whole picture is yours to remember. Then it comes apart.

Pieces fall at a steady pace. Slide a piece sideways, turn it, or flip it, and it keeps coming down. You cannot park it in the air. When it reaches the floor, the next piece waits five seconds, then falls. Next shows that piece and counts the wait. A faint ghost marks the landing. A light tune plays until you turn it off in Settings. Sound effects are separate.

Rotate it a quarter turn. Flip it across, or flip it down. The picture is not the same in a mirror, so the facing has to agree, not only the outline. Drop it on the matching part of the picture, or nudge a landed piece and tap Place. The right square and the right facing lock with a click. A wrong one stays in your hands.

A piece that has landed stays where you leave it. Move them apart. If four unplaced pieces overlap in one pile, that picture is lost. The piece still falling does not count, and neither does a piece you have already locked. When the last piece has fallen, a 60-second finish clock starts. When it runs out, you win the picture if two or fewer pieces are still out of place or loose; otherwise Start Level Over tries it again.

Twenty levels, each with more pieces than the one before.

Twenty pictures. The first ten are a meadow, a harbor, an orchard, a canyon, a night market, a glacier, an observatory, a reef, a train, and a rose window. The next ten are a kite hill, a bakery, a pond, a clock tower, a fair, a snow village, a library, a pumpkin patch, a ferry, and a firework garden. Each frame asks for more than the one before it. The last three keep 52 pieces and grow the board. Early frames trace the sockets. Later ones leave you with the memory of the ten seconds.

Puzzled Puzzler stays on this device. No account, no network, no ads, no purchases.

apps.name: GoreBox 27
apps.description:
GoreBox 27 is a physics sandbox shooter. Every character is a GoreDoll: a full ragdoll with its own skeleton, organs and blood.

Play alone, against bots or online with other players.

DAMAGE
• Damage is tracked per body part: broken bones, failing organs and blood loss from each wound
• Lose the arm holding a gun and the gun falls. Lose the legs or break the spine and the GoreDoll crawls
• Knockouts, concussions and bleeding out, with GoreDolls that wake up and get back on their feet
• Blades and axes take off arms, legs and heads, and explosions tear bodies apart
• Wounds and burns stay on bodies, and blood stays on the ground
• Your own character takes the same damage, down to bruises and torn clothing
• The Body Inspector shows a body's vitals and organ function, and Status Indicators show how your character feels

FIRE, EXPLOSIVES AND RADIATION
• Fire spreads through grass, wood, cloth and spilled fuel, and smoke fills rooms and chokes GoreDolls
• GoreDolls catch fire and burn to death unless the fire is put out
• Explosives from propane tanks and gas cans to missiles, the Neutron Bottle and the Aerial Bomb, a nuclear bomb
• Radioactive fallout drifts with the wind, causes radiation sickness and can turn GoreDolls into Mutants

WEAPONS AND PROPS
• Firearms with recoil and handling based on real calibres
• Bullets go through walls, depending on the calibre and the wall's thickness
• 25 melee weapons, from the Katana to the Frying Pan, with heavy swings and blocking
• The Reality Crusher: grab anything physical, fling it, tear it apart or crush it, and build fences and walls
• Over 200 props, including turrets, TVs, live cameras, jump pads and teleporters

BOTS AND NPCS
• Ten kinds of NPC, from Regulars and Officers to Convicts, Maniacs, Mutants and Divines, each with its own background. Some fight back, some run and some surrender
• Bots take cover, react to gunshots, search where they last saw you, fight with melee weapons and man turrets
• Set each NPC's skill, and save an NPC with its weapons, look and side as your own spawn card

MULTIPLAYER
• Crossplay between PC and mobile
• Host a game for friends, invite them from your friends list, or browse public servers
• Dedicated servers, LAN games, voice and text chat, and vote-kicks
• Hosts set the rules, kick players, sell roles and run their server's own money, GB$
• Clans, each with its own bank and emblem

GAMEMODES
• Sandbox, with no rules or objectives
• Free for all, Team deathmatch, Gun Game, Maniac Mystery, Infection, Mutant survival, Juggernaut, Riot, Invasion and more
• Bots can fill in for players in any gamemode
• Make your own gamemodes from triggers and actions, with lives, teams, zones and secret roles

WORLD
• Day and night, with a moon that goes through its phases, and clouds, rain and storms
• A car to drive, which hurts whoever it hits and whoever is inside when it crashes

CREATE YOUR OWN
• Build maps in the Map Editor on PC, with houses, working doors, lifts and water to swim in, and play them straight away
• Publish maps on the Workshop and play the ones other players made
• Save a scene with everything built in it, its NPCs and where everyone stands, and load it again later
• Customise your character down to the face, with hairstyles, beards, hats, masks and clothes in any colour

Full controller support, and touch controls on mobile.

EARLY ACCESS
This is an early access version of GoreBox 27. You will run into bugs, and parts of the game are unfinished or still missing. Nothing you see here is final.

GoreBox 27 is only a few months old and has far less content than GoreBox Animosity for now. New updates will keep adding more. If you find a bug, please report it on our Discord server.

GoreBox 27 contains graphic violence, blood and gore, and online interaction with other players. It is not made for children.

apps.name: Wordeex
apps.description:
Ever been lost for words? Wordeex turns that feeling into a word puzzle game.

16 letters. A hidden set of words. Can you find them?

Each puzzle starts with a keyboard made from the letters of three to five hidden words. Your task is to find those specific words and use every letter.

Find a correct word and its letters disappear, leaving you with the letters you need for the remaining answers. But there’s a twist: a real word isn’t always one of the words you’re looking for.

Sometimes the answer jumps out at you. Sometimes you stare right at it and swear it doesn’t exist.

Then, suddenly, you see it.

That’s Wordeex.

EVERY WORD CHANGES THE PUZZLE
Vocabulary helps. Logic makes the difference. Find a word, watch its letters disappear and take another look at what’s left. Your next answer could be right there.

GUESS, RETHINK, TRY AGAIN
Haven’t found the right word yet? Keep going. Your previous guesses stay visible, and a counter shows when you’ve tried the same word more than once. Yes, it happens.

A NEW CHALLENGE EVERY DAY
Take on the daily Wordeex, shared by everyone playing in the same language. Solve it and share your result with friends.

EXPLORE THE CHAPTERS
Work your way through puzzles with different levels of difficulty. Some reveal starting letters and word lengths. Others show only the lengths. The toughest reveal neither.

TEST YOUR SKILLS IN ACADEMY
Ready for a greater challenge? Academy is a competitive mode with no hints. It adapts to your skill based on your completion times and number of guesses. As you improve, tackle puzzles with less common words and solve tougher challenges to climb the leagues faster.

CREATE A CHALLENGE OF YOUR OWN
Build your own Wordeex and share it with friends or the community. Can they uncover the words you’ve hidden?

PLAY OFFLINE
No connection? Keep solving Wordeex wherever you are—even in airplane mode.

EXPLORE 27 LANGUAGES

apps.description:
Bubble Blitz is a bubble popping puzzle where every level gives you a fixed number of shots to clear the board.

Shoot bubbles at matching colors to make them disappear. A single shot can also cut bubbles loose from whatever they’re hanging on, so they drop off the board even if they don’t match your color.

How to Play:

- Aim your shot and release to send a bubble at the board.
- Match bubbles of the same color to clear them.
- Cut a cluster loose from above to drop extra bubbles at once, matching or not.
- Choose between two bubbles before each shot to pick the color you need.
- Clear every bubble on the board to finish the level.

How to get good at Bubble Blitz

Slow down before each move and read the whole board for the biggest cluster instead of grabbing the closest match. A shot that cuts a big group loose from above often clears more than one that only matches a color. Rings Out is a relaxing rotate ring game where you turn linked circles, line up their gaps, and free every piece to clear the board. Give each circle a little turn, rotate rings and watch the puzzle come apart!

Settle into a satisfying mix: rotate rings and slide bars, creating space to unlock each piece. One small move can open the way for the next, so take a moment to see how everything connects, and untie the rings! A ring that's stuck now might come free after you shift a bar or turn a neighboring circle. Enjoy working out the sequence at your own pace—this rotate ring game gives you enough time to think.

How to Play Rings Out

- Touch and drag a ring or half-ring to rotate it.
- Align the gaps so linked pieces can be released.
- Check what's blocking each piece and move it out of the way.
- Keep untangling until the board is clear.

A Few Extra Twists

Straight and L-shaped bars add another layer to each puzzle. Slide them back and forth along a fixed line to clear the way and unlock rings. You'll need to think about both turns and slides as you work through the whole arrangement.

When you need a little help, use the bomb booster. It removes one random element from the board, giving you fewer pieces to untangle and making the ring puzzle easier to solve.

Why You'll Love Rings Out

- Relaxing gameplay: Pause, consider your options, and enjoy figuring things out in your own time.
- Simple touch-and-drag controls: Turn and slide pieces with a simple drag of your finger.
- Logic challenges: This ring puzzle, like many other logic games, gives you a chance to train your brain and plan a few moves ahead, putting your observation and planning skills to work.
- Two ways to untangle: Rotate rings and slide bars to find a solution for every level of this circle game.
- Satisfying progress: Enjoy every piece you release, from the first opening to the last ring when a tricky tangle finally comes apart.

How to Master Rings Out

Take a look at the whole board of this circle game before you start turning. Pick a ring and trace what's keeping it locked, then work backward to find your first move. Try moving nearby pieces to create an opening—even a small slide can make room for a useful turn. Think a few moves ahead, experiment, and finally untie the rings!

Take a quiet break and train your logic skills with Rings Out! Rotate rings, slide bars, and discover how the pieces fit together—and how to untangle all of them!

apps.name: Numhop: Math Puzzle
apps.description:
Place the tiles. Wire the numbers. Hit every target.

Numhop is a calm math puzzle about numbers that run down a board. Numbers wait at the top, targets sit at the bottom, and every target needs its own number. Connect them with operation tiles and splitters, then watch the numbers hurry along the wires, adding, subtracting, multiplying and dividing on the way.

How it works
Pick the tiles you need, place them on the board and draw wires between them. Each number follows the wires and changes at every tile it passes. Once each target receives the number it asks for, the level is solved. Solve it with fewer tiles and you earn more stars.

Puzzle mechanics
• Operation tiles — add, subtract, multiply or divide the number that passes through
• Splitters — fork a wire so one number can travel to several places
• Wires — link numbers, tiles and targets to build the route
• Star rating — fewer tiles used means more stars for the level
• Multi-answer targets — some targets accept several different numbers, so more than one solution works
• Walls, fractions and negatives — later boards add obstacles and numbers below zero or between whole ones

Made for calm thinking
The game has 33 levels. A short tutorial comes first, then the puzzles get more interesting. There are no timers, so you can think each wire through at your own pace. A wrong move is easy to take back with undo, and if a board leaves you stuck, the game can show the solution.

Place a tile, connect a wire and let the numbers hop.

Encounter creepy characters who watch your every move, chase you, and turn an ordinary shift into a nightmare. Stay alert as you try to keep your stand running while things get stranger around you.

Survive the Night 💀
Brace yourself for horror nights filled with jumpscares, strange encounters, and unexplained events. Stay focused, complete your tasks, and make it through another night shift. In this survival horror game, even a routine order can lead to a frightening surprise.

Earn Money & Complete Tasks 💰
Serve customers, complete tasks, and earn money to keep your hot dog stand in business. Balance the demands of horror cooking with the challenge of making it through the night. Can you handle everything your shift throws at you?

🌭 Key Features
- Cook and serve hot dogs
- Meet bizarre and terrifying customers
- Experience jumpscares and unexpected events
- Complete tasks and earn money
- Survive horror nights full of strange encounters
- Uncover the mystery behind your unusual customers

Into horror games? Step behind the counter and find out what happens when an ordinary job takes a terrifying turn. In this spooky game, the orders keep coming, the customers get stranger, and every shift tests your nerves. If creepy games and scary games are your thing, see if you can make it through the night!

apps.name: Happy Fishing Village
apps.description:
Ready to dive into a fin-tastic adventure? 
Welcome to your very own little fishing village, where every catch brings a new surprise! Cast your net, catch colorful fish, build a charming seaside town, and turn your tiny harbor into a thriving fishing paradise!
Whether you're chasing a big catch, growing your village, or hanging out with adorable animal friends, there's always something fun waiting by the sea. Take it easy, enjoy the ocean breeze, and create your own happy fishing life!
--What a Catch!
There's always something exciting beneath the waves! Cast your net, reel in amazing catches, and discover the joy of fishing. You never know what you'll catch next!
-- Catch More Fish!
Explore the sparkling blue waters and catch all kinds of colorful fish! Fill your nets, discover new species, and enjoy the thrill of a great catch.
-- Build Your Village!
Start with a tiny fishing village and make it your own! Restore and upgrade buildings, expand your harbor, and watch your little seaside town grow into a bustling paradise.
--Earn and Grow!
Turn your fishing adventures into a thriving business! Collect rewards, grow your earnings, and unlock exciting upgrades to make your village bigger and better.
 --Meet Your Pals!
Life is better with cute companions! Meet adorable animal friends, collect your favorites, and fill your seaside adventure with even more joy.

Your dream fishing village is just one catch away! 
Catch fish, build your village, make new friends, and enjoy the simple pleasures of life by the sea.
Ready to make a splash? Your fishing adventure starts now!

apps.name: Grab Cat Hospital
apps.description:
Welcome to Grab Cat Hospital, a fun and addictive physics puzzle game where you'll meet strange, unique cats that never seem to stay still!

Your mission is simple: pull the cat to the finish line. But these cats are anything but ordinary! They have unexpected behaviors, funny personalities, and a stubborn attitude. Tap and hold to pull the cat forward, but the moment you let go, it will immediately run back to where it started!

Stay patient, plan your route, and pull the cat through all kinds of obstacles to reach the finish safely. Don't let their unusual looks fool you—these adorable cats are full of surprises!

Every level features a new layout filled with obstacles, traps, and hilarious situations. Observe carefully, master your timing, and find the best way to guide these quirky cats to the finish line.

With simple one-touch controls and satisfying physics-based gameplay, Grab Cat Hospital is easy to play but increasingly challenging to master.

GAME FEATURES

• Tap and hold to pull strange cats forward.
• Release your finger, and the cat runs back!
• Every cat has a unique look and funny reactions.
• Every level brings a brand-new challenge.
• Dodge obstacles and overcome unexpected situations.
• Master your timing and route to reach the finish.
• Simple controls that are easy to learn but hard to master.
• Funny animations and unexpected character reactions.
• Smooth physics-based gameplay.
• Hundreds of unique and challenging levels.

Every level brings a new surprise. Cats can run, bounce, get pulled back, or do things you never expected. Test your reflexes, improve your timing, and figure out the best way to control these unpredictable characters!

No two levels are exactly alike. As you progress, the obstacles become more unpredictable, and the cats become... even stranger!

Whether you love puzzle games, casual games, physics-based challenges, or simply enjoy cats with personalities like no other, Grab Cat Hospital delivers a fun and surprising experience that will keep you coming back for more.

Can you pull all the strange cats to the finish line?

Download Grab Cat Hospital now and discover the most unique cats around!

apps.name: Lil' Guardsman
apps.description:
Enjoy 10% off during the first two weeks after launch!

👋 Hi, I'm Lil! I'm 12 years old, and today I’m on gate guard duty. What’s that? You don’t think it’s appropriate for a kid to decide who should, and shouldn’t enter the kingdom? You don’t think a 12 year old should be able to send people to the dungeon!? You and me both! But my dad left me in charge, so I guess I don’t have a choice. 
Between shady goblins, haughty elves, and sketchiest of all… humans, I have to conduct interrogations, uncover plots, and survive my shift. Approve, deny, or jail, the fate of the city literally rests on my pre-teen shoulders!

⚖️ Lil’ Guardsman is a comedic, fantasy riff on the border control genre. Every visitor who shows up at the guard shed is a real puzzle that will put your deduction skills to the test. The player must choose to follow, or break, the kingdom’s rules to inspect travelers, identify deception, and make strategic choices.

🪄 As Lil, you must use your wits to outsmart the deceptions of a colorful cast of characters. Letting the wrong person in, or incorrectly sending someone straight to the dungeon, can radically change the course of history, unleashing chaos upon the city. Your individual decisions shape an epic story across twelve levels, a wedding, and a war (that you trigger!) 
 
⚙️ GAME FEATURES

• Full Premium Game: Pay once to unlock the entire adventure. No ads, no microtransactions, no virtual currency.

• Border Post Simulation: Over 100 unique characters to meet, interrogate, and decide the fate of, according to evolving security rules.

• Deduction Mechanics: Use an upgradeable arsenal of tools (Truth Spray, Whip, Metal Detector, and more) with limited uses per day (resource management).

• Interrogation System: Choose your dialogue carefully. Confiscate contraband items, call royal advisors to verify information, and make the final choice to Admit, Deny, or Jail.

• Branching Narrative: Your decisions at the castle gates have direct consequences for the main characters, the kingdom of the Sprawl, and the game's ultimate ending.

• Technical Compatibility: Solo experience optimized for touch screens, 100% playable offline (no internet connection required after the initial installation).

🏅 CRITICAL ACCLAIM AND AWARDS (PC VERSION)
Building on its PC success, Lil' Guardsman has been widely praised by critics and has shined in indie festivals:

🏆 IndieCade Festival: Winner of the Best Performance award for its excellent voice cast.

🏆 Game Development World Championship (GDWC): Winner of the prestigious Studio Award and finalist in the Best Adventure Game, Best Music, and Immersive Audio categories.

🏆 Indie Cup: Winner of the Critics' Choice Award.

⭐ Notable Nominations: Nominated for Best Debut Game at the Indie Games Awards, praised for its plot ("Outstanding Story-Rich Game") at the Steam Awards, and nominated in multiple categories at the Canadian Game Awards (including Game of the Year).

apps.name: Thrifty Business
apps.description:
[TRY BEFORE YOU BUY]
Try the first 60 minutes of Thrifty Business for free! If you like it, you can unlock the full game with a one-time purchase!

There’s a brand new thrift store in town, and guess what? You’re in charge!

In Thrifty Business, you’ll set up and manage your very own 90’s-inspired vintage thrift shop. Search through boxes filled with pre-loved gems and use them to create gorgeous displays. Unlock furniture, decorations, wallpaper & floors to create a beautiful community space that brings everybody together!

Adjust your layout and organize your shelves and racks to the finest detail. Group your wares by colour, theme, purpose, or whatever you like. The more organized your store is, the more community points you’ll get to unlock new goodies!

Customize the furniture, wallpaper, flooring and decor to make your store as welcoming and cozy as possible. As business grows, you might even need to expand into the adjacent rooms!

This is so much more than just a store. Listen to customer’s stories and try to fulfill their requests. You can also unlock and host hobbyist events, turning your business into a treasured third space for locals!

🛍️ What Thrifty Business has in store for you:
- laid-back management sim
- colorful 90s-inspired graphics
- 500+ different items to add to your shelves
- precision placing so you can organize exactly how you want
- customization options: furniture, decorations, wallpaper & flooring
- a quirky and unique cast of customers

🙅‍♀️ What you won’t find on our shelves:
- stressful min-maxing to get the best possible profit
- setting item prices or haggling
- impatient customers that leave your store in anger

apps.name: Absolum
apps.description:
A magical cataclysm left magic mistrusted by the common folk and Sun King Azra took advantage of this panic, enslaving wizards through his Crimson Order and conquering more and more lands. With the help of high enchantress Uchawi, a small group of rebels rises from the shadows.

Fight as the outcast heroes of Talamh in a fierce battle to retake magic from Sun King Azra’s grasp in Absolum, an original roguelite beat ‘em up by Dotemu.

FEATURES

​🌌 Join the rebellion! With the help of the high enchantress Uchawi, wield forbidden magic to free the lands of Talamh from the iron grip of Sun King Azra.

⚔️ Four heroes, each with their own fighting style: start playing as the calm but deadly Galandra or as Karl, the last free dwarf of Talamh, and discover the prodigious Brome and the enigmatic Cider as they join your journey.

💥 Craft new strategies and get more powerful every run to defeat Azra’s elite guard through a gameplay that blends the best of arcade beat’em up action with modern roguelite mechanics.

​🗺️ -From the majestic mines of Grandery to the lush forests of Jaroba, delve into an original fantasy world that comes alive through gorgeous art, masterful animation and a magnificent soundtrack by composer Gareth Coker (Ori, Halo Infinite, Prince of Persia), featuring collaborations with other legendary composers.

​🤝 Lead the uprising against Azra's regime as a lone hero, or team up with an ally through the two-player online coop mode. Combine your elemental powers and synchronize your attacks into incredible chained combos!

CAREFULLY REDESIGNED FOR MOBILE
- Revamped interface – exclusive mobile UI with complete touch control
- Google Play Games achievements
-Buy once, play anywhere: Enjoy cross-progression on mobile and PC with the same Google Play Games account
- Cloud Save – Share your progress between Android devices
-Compatible with controllers

apps.name: Clone Drone in the Danger Zone
apps.description:
Clone Drone in the Danger Zone is a robot voxel slice-em-up where any part of your body can be sliced off. With your mind downloaded into a robot gladiator, you must survive the sinister trials of the arena. You can finally play the indie action hit on the go. It's Clone Drone on your mobile phone!

Single Player Game Modes

• Story Mode - One part epic tale of human defiance, another part laser swords.
• Endless Mode - Challenge yourself to fight through 86 level variants spread across 7 difficulty tiers. Can you make it to TITANIUM?
• Challenge Mode - Bow-only, hammer-only, can you still survive the arena?

Multiplayer Game Modes

• Last Bot Standing - A Battle-Royale-like game mode with short, 5-10 minute play sessions and up to 15 players. Survive, and shower in the remains of your fellow robot competitors.
• Private Duels - Challenge your friend to a 1v1 duel!
• Online Co-op! - Use the power of human friendship (and laser swords!) to survive in the arena!

Features:

• Epic Voxel Dismemberment: In addition to looking cool, the ability to cut off body parts is central to the gameplay. Jumping on one leg is a common occurrence. Large enemies need to be cut down to size before a fatal blow can be delivered.
• Sharp Sword Combat: Combat is fast and intense, putting great emphasis on movement, timing and positioning. You are never safe, as any blow can instantly kill or dismember.
• Intuitive Controls: On-screen buttons allow you to smoothly jump, dash, and destroy any robot adversary.
• Spin Attack: Perform a deadly 360 spin in this mobile exclusive attack!
• Entertaining Commentary: Commentatron and Analysis-Bot provide a play-by-play of your performance and react to your activities.
• Upgrade Your Robot: Jetpack, bow, kicking, deflection, clones, armor, FIRE BREATH.
• Terrifying Robotic Enemies: They actually get pretty hard! Sword robots, bow robots, Spidertron 5000, Spidertron 6000, gigantic hammer bots. So many things to dismember.
• Achievements! Unlock upgrades, emotes and multiplayer skins by achieving a rich variety of things!
• Emotes! Do the Funky Pillar Dance, mock your foes, or flap your arms delightfully!

apps.name: Booster Pack Heroes
apps.description:
*Buy the game now to get a special 30% launch discount ($6.99 instead of $9.99)!*

Booster Pack Heroes is an incremental game where every pack could contain your next powerhouse. Discover heroes and spells, upgrade their abilities, and survive endless monster hordes as you fight your way through the realms.

OPEN PACKS
Rip open booster packs, each with its own pool of heroes and spells. Hunt for rare cards and build a collection powerful enough to crush the toughest foes.

UPGRADE YOUR POWER
Survive to earn Mastery. Use it to upgrade your heroes and spells, unlock powerful new abilities, and turn your collection into an unstoppable force.

SURVIVE THE HORDE
Monsters are coming for the tower. Fight through increasingly dangerous waves, unleash devastating abilities, and push your survival as far as you can.

TRAVEL BETWEEN REALMS
Defeat each chapter's boss to unlock new booster packs, heroes, spells, and challenges. Every run feeds the next, giving you more power and letting you survive a bit longer.
…and there's more to discover beyond the tower. Travel between mysterious planes of existence, each with its own secrets.

The cycle has repeated countless times.
You're here to break it.

apps.name: ONE PIECE: Grand Gourmet
apps.description:
ONE PIECE comes to life as a restaurant management sim game!

As a new staff member, work alongside the Straw Hat Crew to turn the second location of the renowned Baratie floating restaurant into the greatest restaurant of the seas!

-Dish Out a Signature Menu
Get inspired by characters' ideas, choose your ingredients, and work with Sanji to cook delicious dishes. Arrange them into unique meal sets by adding different flourishes, then adventure to find even more recipes! From iconic series favorites like Water-Water Meat BBQ and Sea King Penne Gorgonzola to special creations that harness the powers of Devil Fruits, a treasure trove of dishes awaits.

-Design A Tasteful Interior
Choose from over 200 furniture, building, and decorative items to make your restaurant uniquely yours! From dessert-themed Whole Cake Island pieces to futuristic Egghead items, the customization options are as vast as the sea. If a character likes your design, they may even become a regular!

-Table for 400
From the Straw Hat Crew and beyond, over 400 ONE PIECE characters appear as staff and customers in a spritely pixel style for the first time in a game! With so many characters, you'll experience character events and special character interactions that can’t be found anywhere else.

apps.name: The Roottrees are Dead
apps.description:
INCLUDES A SECOND MYSTERY: ROOTREEMANIA

IT’S THE LATE ’90s

A private jet belonging to the Roottree Corporation has crashed. On board were the three Roottree sisters and their parents—together worth more than a billion dollars.

Under the eccentric wishes of their great-great-grandfather, Elias Roottree, the family fortune must now be divided among every surviving blood relative.

But who is actually related by blood?

That’s where you come in.

SEARCH THE EARLY INTERNET

Use a dial-up-era computer to search archived websites, old newspapers, interviews, advertisements, photographs, books, and other records. Look for names, faces, dates, occupations, and connections.

CROSS-REFERENCE EVERY CLUE

Compare details across different sources. A single discovery may reveal a forgotten relative, expose a hidden relationship, or unlock an entirely new branch of the family.

REBUILD THE FAMILY TREE

Place each person where they belong. Every correct deduction narrows the possibilities—but as the tree grows, the evidence becomes harder to find and the relationships more difficult to prove.

TRUST YOUR REASONING

Read closely, take notes, connect the facts, and decide where to investigate next. Your only tools are an old computer, careful observation, and deductive logic.

FEATURES

• Search a richly detailed recreation of the late-90s internet
• Identify people through photographs, articles, and scattered records
• Cross-reference names, occupations, relationships, and timelines
• Complete and verify an ever-expanding family tree
• Uncover the secrets hidden within the Roottree bloodline

Every correct name brings you closer to the truth—and perhaps to an even greater lie.

Can you complete the Roottree family tree?


CONTACT US
support.m@indieark.com

apps.name: ChessGame
apps.description:
Learn chess, play chess offline against the computer and solve chess puzzles — all in one app. ChessGame teaches complete beginners how to play chess, then gives you a real chess engine to beat at 6 levels. No ads, no account, no Wi-Fi needed.

♛ LEARN CHESS STEP BY STEP — FROM BEGINNER TO WINNER
Never played before? Start at move one. The Learn course takes you through 21 chapters and 58 chess lessons: how the pieces move, check and checkmate, castling, en passant and pawn promotion, then chess tactics like forks and pins, and the opening principles strong players use. Every lesson has a live chess board with the legal squares highlighted, and every chapter ends with a short test. Get one wrong and ChessGame shows you the right move — like a patient chess coach in your pocket.

♚ PLAY CHESS VS COMPUTER — 6 AI LEVELS
Play chess against the computer from Beginner to Master, or set an exact Elo rating for a custom challenge. The chess AI runs on your phone, so it answers instantly, even in airplane mode. Beginners get an opponent they can beat; experienced players get a strong engine that punishes every mistake. Play white, black or random, ask for a hint when you're stuck, and take back a move.

♞ CHESS PUZZLES & TACTICS TRAINER
Train your tactics with a daily puzzle and random puzzles — back-rank mates, forks, pins and other classic checkmate patterns — with instant feedback on every move.

♜ CHESS OPENINGS
Explore 42 named openings, from the Italian Game and Ruy López to the Sicilian Defense, and play each line on a live board to learn the ideas behind the moves.

♝ 2 PLAYER CHESS ON ONE DEVICE
Play chess with a friend or family member. Pass and play with a full move list, captured pieces and a flip-board button.

🏆 DAILY GOALS, STREAKS & BADGES
Finish a daily goal to build your streak, unlock badges and earn diamonds to spend on hints and take-backs. Turn on a gentle daily reminder if you like.

✨ A CLASSIC CHESS BOARD, BEAUTIFULLY MADE
• Warm wooden classic board with a full-screen mode and one-tap landscape
• 9 board themes and 10 piece sets
• Clear highlights for your selected piece, legal moves and the last move
• Light and dark mode
• Sound and vibration you can switch off
• Saved games you can resume, replay and share as PGN
• Statistics from your own games

🌍 31 LANGUAGES
Available in English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Italian, Russian, Ukrainian, Turkish, Arabic, Hindi, Telugu, Indonesian, Vietnamese, Thai, Japanese, Korean, Chinese and more.

🔒 OFFLINE & PRIVATE
No ads. No sign-in. No tracking. Your games, progress and statistics stay on your device. The game, lessons and puzzles all work offline — perfect for flights, commutes and anywhere without internet.

PERFECT FOR
• Beginners who want to learn how to play chess
• Kids and families learning chess together
• Casual players who want a quick offline chess game
• Club players who want a strong chess computer to practise against
• Anyone who loves strategy board games and brain training

Download ChessGame — learn chess, play chess and get better every day.

apps.name: The Farmer Was Replaced
apps.description:
Program a drone. Automate a farm. Watch your code do the work.

The Farmer Was Replaced is a programming game where your drone does the farming. Write short programs in a simple, Python-like language, press execute, and your drone tills, plants, waters and harvests, with results that depend on your code.

No levels, just continuous progression: farm resources, buy unlocks, solve the next problem. Harvest hay, wood and carrots, merge pumpkins into a giant one, sort cacti, find the best sunflower, feed a dinosaur and hunt for treasure in a hedge maze. Become the most efficient farmer in the world.

A CODE KEYBOARD MADE FOR TOUCH
Every symbol you need on one screen. Brackets and quotes come in pairs. Swipe on any key to move the cursor, hold Shift and swipe to select. Undo, redo, comment and paste have their own row. Choose QWERTY, QWERTZ or AZERTY, with key clicks or vibration. Prefer real keys? Connect a Bluetooth keyboard and mouse for more comfortable coding.

LEARN TO CODE
Loops, variables, functions, lists and more, introduced one at a time. The game gives you the tools, but solving the tasks is up to you, and that can be a real challenge. Already a programmer? Race through the basics, then run a fleet of drones.

THE MINER WAS REPLACED, INCLUDED
Take your drone underground and unlock eight new resources, including coal, quartz, mushrooms and dynamite. Dig up ancient ruins without damaging them, sort mushrooms, grow rice on clay and play Minesweeper without blowing up your drone.

TRY BEFORE YOU BUY
Try the game for free. After the trial, you’ll need to unlock the full game with a one-time purchase to keep playing. No ads, no subscriptions.

FEATURES
• A real programming language
• Custom code keyboard and support for Bluetooth keyboards and mice
• Portrait or landscape on phones and tablets
• Megafarm: several drones in parallel
• Simulation mode for fast, reproducible testing
• Unlockable achievements
• Hats. Your drone deserves them.
• 14 languages

apps.name: iChess
apps.description:
Chess for kids, beginners and the whole family. iChess turns learning chess into a bright, friendly adventure: easy lessons, checkmate puzzles and a computer opponent that starts gentle and grows with you. No ads, no sign-in and no internet needed.

Every lesson is played on a real board with the legal squares lit up, and each chapter ends with a little test. Miss a move and iChess kindly shows the right one.

Find the winning move! Solve a daily chess puzzle and hand-picked checkmate puzzles like the back-rank mate and the two-rook ladder. Stuck? Ask for a hint or see the solution, then try again.

Start at Beginner, then move up to Easy, Intermediate, Advanced, Expert and Master as you improve, or pick an exact strength. The chess computer lives inside the app, so it plays instantly, even in airplane mode. Take back a move, ask for a hint and keep learning from every game.

♝ PLAY WITH FAMILY AND FRIENDS
Two players can share one phone or tablet: perfect for a parent and child, brothers and sisters, or friends at school.

🏆 DAILY GOALS, STREAKS AND BADGES
Finish a small daily goal to grow a streak, collect up to 12 badges and earn diamonds to spend on hints and take-backs. A gentle daily reminder is there if you want it.

♜ CHESS OPENINGS
Curious kids can explore 42 famous openings, like the Italian Game, the Queen's Gambit and the Sicilian Defense, and play every line on the board.

Learn chess in English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Italian, Russian, Ukrainian, Turkish, Arabic, Hindi, Telugu, Indonesian, Vietnamese, Thai, Japanese, Korean, Chinese and many more.

apps.name: BrainyPet: Kids Learning Pet
apps.description:
Welcome to BrainyPet—a gentle, ethical, and psychologically-informed educational game designed just for children aged 3 to 6.
Created by a dad looking for a better, safer digital space for his own kids, BrainyPet combines the joy of nurturing a virtual pet with foundational learning in Maths, English, and Science.

We believe children's apps should be ethical and stress-free. That is why BrainyPet features:

• No Microtransactions: No hidden fees or real-money storefronts.

BrainyPet encourages early learners to care for small things and develop empathy.

Give your child a safe, educational screen-time companion today!

apps.name: Ai Game Maker: Create Games
apps.description:
Meet your next favorite game, or create games of your own. Ai Game Maker brings community-made browser games into a mobile feed and discovery catalog. Browse fresh ideas, open a game, and play right from your phone.

Relaxing train tracks puzzles set in rural England.

apps.name: Printa: 3D Printing Tycoon
apps.description:
One gift changed everything: a 3D printer! Now it's up to you to turn ideas into prints, prints into orders, and orders into coins in your piggy bank.

Printa is a cozy tycoon where a kid builds their own 3D printing business at home — and learns how money works along the way.

HOW IT WORKS
• In the morning you take finished orders to school. In the afternoon you come home with the payment and new requests.
• Choose which orders to take: compare the price with the cost and see right away if you can deliver in time.
• Grow beyond school: buy a phone to sell on social media and a computer to open your online store.
• Plan the print queue so your printers keep working while you study and sleep.
• Calibrate machines, replace worn parts and keep them from breaking at the worst moment.
• At the end of the month, the report shows whether you finished in the black and hit your goal.

LEARN BY PLAYING
• Revenue, costs and profit explained with a piggy bank and a cash-flow chart.
• Investing: better machines cost a lot today but earn more tomorrow.
• Depreciation: a used printer is worth less when you sell it.
• Planning: rush orders pay more, but the deadline is tight.
• Fixed costs, fees and salary: the phone plan, the online store fee and your helper all count in the month.
• The game's money is pretend (P$): it can't be bought or withdrawn with real money.

PLENTY TO DO
• 13 kinds of prints: keychains, articulated dinos, rockets, trophies, phone cases and more.
• 6 printers to buy and upgrade, including multicolor machines with up to 4 colors, and an iron shelf with 6 slots.
• New features unlocked at every level, monthly themes (science fair, school championship...) and a helper to hire.
• A first-day tutorial and an original soundtrack.

Every word you find brings you closer to interesting facts about the world. 🧠 Think of them as word riddles that test your vocabulary.
 
Factifact works like a reverse crossword without a grid. ⛏️ Classic crossword puzzles give you a clue and a row of empty squares. Here you start from the clue and dig down to the hidden word. Fans of word puzzle games will feel at home right away. Every brainteaser blends vocabulary, reasoning and general knowledge in one sequence. Short brain teasers like these make a calm mental workout at any time.
 
Guess the word correctly and the next layer of the puzzle opens. Unlike most word quiz games, every answer becomes part of the next clue. These trivia questions reward careful reading and patient thinking. Solving puzzles here feels like piecing a small story together. What you will find inside:
💡 A hint when a clue feels too tricky
❤️ Three hearts per fact, so every guess counts
🏺 A dig site that uncovers a hidden find with each solved word
📌 A board where every solved fact is pinned as a colorful note

The facts cover nature, geography, animals and much more. 🏺 One puzzle explains why honey can stay fresh for centuries. Another shows how Mount Everest is still growing. apps.name: Vial Magic: Color Sort
apps.description:
Vial Magic: Color Sort is a single-player water sorting puzzle game with a collectible CG illustration gallery. Players solve levels by moving colored liquid between bottles, then progress through the game to unlock pictures for their collection.

WHAT YOU DO IN THE GAME

The main activity is sorting colored water. Each level displays bottles containing several layers of different colors. You must move the liquid between these bottles until every non-empty bottle contains only one color.

The colors remain separate layers. You are organizing them, not mixing them to create new colors.

HOW THE POURING CONTROLS WORK

Tap a bottle to select it, then tap another bottle to pour liquid into it.

A pour is allowed when the destination bottle has enough empty space and either contains no liquid or has the same color on top as the liquid being moved.

Only the uppermost color can be poured. To move a color underneath another layer, you must first remove the liquid above it. You cannot pour into a full bottle or place a color on top of a different color.

Continue moving the layers until the colors are separated into single-color bottles. Bottles that are not needed can remain empty.

EXAMPLE OF A MOVE

If one bottle has blue liquid above red liquid, you must move the blue liquid before you can access the red.

You can pour that blue liquid into an empty bottle or another bottle with blue liquid on top, as long as there is enough room. Removing the blue layer exposes the red layer and creates another possible move.

SOLVING THE LEVELS

Look at the arrangement before choosing a bottle. Empty bottles provide temporary storage and help you reach colors trapped beneath other layers.

A move that matches two colors may still leave you without enough space for the next step. Consider both the color you are moving and the layer that will be exposed afterward.

Completing the sorting objective clears the current level and allows you to continue to the next puzzle.

CG ILLUSTRATION COLLECTION

In addition to the water sorting levels, Vial Magic: Color Sort includes CG artwork, meaning digital illustrations that players can unlock and collect.

Progress through the puzzle levels to meet the game's artwork unlock requirements. Unlocked illustrations become available in the in-game gallery, where you can open and view the pictures you have collected.

The illustrations are collection content, separate from the sorting board. The core gameplay remains moving colored liquid between bottles to solve puzzles.

MAIN FUNCTIONS

Water sorting levels with layered colored liquids.

Tap controls for selecting a source bottle and a destination bottle.

Pouring rules based on matching colors and available bottle space.

Level progression through completed sorting puzzles.

Collectible CG illustrations unlocked through game progress.

An in-game gallery for viewing unlocked artwork.

Vial Magic: Color Sort combines bottle-sorting puzzles with picture collection. Solve the liquid arrangements, advance through the levels, and build your CG illustration collection.

﻿

4. Handle Special Rings: Plan around linked rotations and frozen pieces.
5. Keep Unraveling: New puzzle sections may appear. Clear every ring and rod to win.

· More Than Circles: Work through combinations of rings and rods.

· Contact Bombs: Bring a bomb into contact with another piece to trigger an explosion and unlock the pieces involved.

Getting started is easy, but clearing a crowded board takes observation and planning. An arrow that blocks your way now could be the key to your next move. Study the connections and decide which path to open first.

UNTANGLE EACH BOARD
Work through different arrow arrangements and discover how each move changes the puzzle. Look for openings around the edges, trace blocked paths, and turn a tangled layout into a clear board.

FIND YOUR PUZZLE FLOW
Enjoy the satisfaction of watching arrows slide away as your plan comes together. Take a closer look, think a few moves ahead, and discover the solution one tap at a time.

FEATURES
• Easy-to-learn tap controls
• Direction-based logic puzzles
• Varied arrow layouts to untangle
• Gameplay built around observation and move order
• Satisfying board-clearing moments

Ready to make your escape? Download Arrow Escape Mania and find a way out for every arrow!

apps.name: Cozy Painting: Coloring Book
apps.description:
Bring Color to the Little Joys of Everyday Life!

Welcome to Cozy Painting: Coloring Book, a relaxing color-by-number game filled with beautiful illustrations inspired by everyday life. From cozy homes and charming interiors to peaceful landscapes, cute animals, and lovely flowers, there’s always something wonderful to color.

Simply follow the numbers, fill each area with the matching colors, and watch every picture come to life. No drawing skills are needed — just choose a picture you love and enjoy coloring at your own pace.

🎨 Explore a Variety of Beautiful Themes

🏡 Houses & Interiors
Discover cozy homes, charming rooms, beautiful decorations, and inviting living spaces.

🌄 Landscapes & Scenery
Color peaceful countryside views, beautiful natural landscapes, and charming places.

🌸 Flowers & Nature
Bring lovely flowers, green plants, and the beauty of nature to life.

🐾 Animals & Pets
Enjoy adorable animals, sweet pets, and heartwarming illustrations.

🧍 People & Daily Life
Explore everyday moments, familiar activities, and scenes full of life.

🍰 Food & Drinks
Color delicious dishes, sweet treats, and delightful food illustrations.

🪴 Still Life & Everyday Objects
Discover beautiful arrangements and the little details that make ordinary things special.

🚗 Vehicles & Transportation
Explore cars and other vehicles through a variety of illustrations.

🙏 Faith & Inspiration
Discover meaningful faith-inspired themes and illustrations.

🌿 Enjoy Coloring Every Day

Easy Color-by-Number Gameplay: Follow the numbers and fill each area with the right color.

Daily Pictures: Find pictures to enjoy every day.

A Relaxing Experience: Take a break, slow down, and color at your own pace.

Share Your Artwork: Share your finished pictures with friends and family.

💛 Make Every Day a Little Cozier

Whether you love cozy interiors, beautiful scenery, cute animals, colorful flowers, or everyday moments, Cozy Painting has something for you. Take a little time for yourself, enjoy the coloring process, and bring more color to your day.

Download Cozy Painting: Coloring Book and start coloring today!

Support & Contact: ordinaryjoy888@gmail.com

apps.name: Smash Party! - 3D Puzzle
apps.description:
Welcome to the biggest little smash party!

Aim your cannon, line up the perfect shot, and turn colorful stacks into a celebration of flying cans, tumbling hay bales, and shattering jam jars. Every hit can set off a satisfying chain reaction and bring the whole structure crashing down.

Each level is a playful 3D physics puzzle. Look for the weak spot, choose your target, and send a party ball into the stack. One well-placed shot can start a spectacular collapse, while trickier levels call for careful aim and smart puzzle solving.

Keep the party rolling with different cannon modes, including Big Ball and Machine Gun. Smash through clever structures, watch objects bounce and tumble, and enjoy the surprise of every physics-driven chain reaction.

Step into a bright backyard celebration filled with balloons, bunting, presents, and playful party colors. With simple aim-and-shoot controls and quick levels, Smash Party! is easy to pick up and full of satisfying shots to master.

GAME FEATURES

- Aim, shoot, and smash with colorful cannons
- Satisfying physics-based destruction and chain reactions
- Clever 3D puzzle levels and stacks to knock down
- Cans, jam jars, hay bales, and more to smash
- Big Ball and Machine Gun cannon modes
- Bright party scenery with balloons and bunting
- Simple controls with rewarding precision shots
- Playful animations and colorful 3D visuals
- Quick levels for a little celebration anytime

The cannon is loaded, the targets are stacked, and the party is ready.

Take aim and let the good times tumble in Smash Party!

apps.name: Sand Art Flow
apps.description:
Let the colors flow in Sand Art Flow!

Discover a satisfying blend of sand sorting and pixel art puzzles. Guide colorful buckets along the conveyor belt, match the right colors, and watch charming pictures come to life, one section at a time.

🪣 TAP, SORT & FILL
Pick your next bucket and send it onto the conveyor. Match the colorful sand to the right spaces and enjoy watching each part of the picture fill with color.

🧠 PLAN YOUR NEXT MOVE
Study the layout and choose your bucket order carefully. As new challenges appear, a thoughtful move can help you clear the way and bring your artwork closer to completion.

✨ GET A LITTLE HELP
A tricky puzzle slowing you down? Use handy boosters to move forward and keep the colors flowing.

🖼️ DISCOVER CHARMING PIXEL ART
Complete levels to reveal delightful pixel designs, from cute animals to colorful scenery. Every finished puzzle adds another creation to your growing collection.

🌈 ENJOY A COLORFUL BREAK
Bright colors, flowing sand, and satisfying reveals turn each puzzle into a cheerful little escape. Take your time and enjoy the transformation as scattered colors become a finished picture.

Whether you have a few spare minutes or time for a longer puzzle session, there’s another colorful creation waiting for you.

Pick a bucket, find your flow, and bring your next masterpiece to life in Sand Art Flow—with the chance to earn a cash reward!

apps.name: Dirt Town: Road Builder 3D
apps.description:
Welcome to Dirt Works: Road Builder, an exciting construction simulator where you transform rough terrain into incredible roads and racing tracks!

Take control of powerful construction machines, push dirt, cut down trees, move rocks, and transport gravel to complete challenging construction tasks. Explore an interactive world with physics-based gameplay and build your own construction empire.

Dig deep pits to collect resources, clear obstacles, and create smooth roads across challenging landscapes. Earn money by completing tasks and unlock new heavy machines to expand your construction capabilities.

Game Features:

Physics-based dirt and terrain simulation

Powerful construction vehicles and heavy machinery

Road building and excavation challenges

Tree cutting and rock-moving activities

Gravel transportation and resource collection

Dirt bike racing track construction

Machine unlocking and progression

Interactive construction environments

Start your construction adventure, operate heavy machinery, and transform an empty landscape into your ultimate dirt construction town!

apps.name: Everything is Crab
apps.description:
Set in a living ecosystem, 'Everything is Crab' is a cute, challenging, highly replayable action roguelite. Make animal inspired evolutionary choices to concoct your own unique creature every run, both mechanically and visually.

BEAT CARCINIZATION
As everybody knows, eventually, every organism ends up evolving into a crab. Right?
Well, except for you. Choose your own evolutionary path and strategy to thrive and defeat convergent evolution. Take that, science!

EVOLVE. ADAPT. OVERCOME
Over 160 abilities combine to create a plethora of different builds and playstyles: Become a wily trickster, a ferocious predator, a gregarious leader, a nimble nomad, or take on any number of other survival strategies.
Legs! Claws! Pincers! Wings! More Legs! Fur! Tail! Scales! Tentacles! I SAID MORE LEGS!!! 
Build your formidable, visually awkward chimera or get Darwin'd in the process.

160+ evolution based abilities
Endless possibilities and visual combinations
Strategy-defining evolutions
Many viable survival strategies and playstyles

A living, thriving ecosystem
Many different critters with their own goals and strategies, each of them with several stages of evolution
Four distinct biomes with different rules, climate events, points of interest, flora and fauna
Night and day cycle

A variety of bosses that may (or may not) appear with each run

Huge meta-progression layer
Difficulties system (if you dare!)
Genetics (starting characters), which can be combined to create endless starting character combinations
Challenge Scenarios (Ice Age, Always Night, Hunted...), to push your adaptation skills to the limit

Endless runs
Prove your survival skills to unlock Endless runs, ditch the timer, and outlast the apocalypse!

Track your findings, meta-progression and achievements in the Codex

apps.name: Panzerkeil
apps.description:
Panzerkeil is a turn-based hex wargame of the Second World War, built for the phone in your hand and the iPad on your desk. Build an army of your own and lead it through the war.

FREE TO START
The opening battles of each campaign, Basic Training, the Daily Operation and Battle Mode against other players are free. One purchase, The Whole War, unlocks every battle on iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple TV, shared with your family. No ads, no subscriptions.

CHOOSE YOUR SIDE
Lead a German army from Poland to Berlin, the British and Americans from Dunkirk to the Elbe, or the Red Army from the frontier in 1941 to the Reichstag: 48 battles on hand-drawn operational maps. How you win decides where the war goes next: a decisive victory opens a different road, a defeat a harder one. Each battle has a voiced briefing, and afterwards a voiced "What really happened" to set your war beside the real one.

AN ARMY THAT REMEMBERS
Your units travel with you from battle to battle. Name them, paint them, and watch them grow from Green to Guards. They win medals with lasting bonuses, from the Iron Cross to the Victoria Cross, and earn traits from what they live through: Tank Hunters, Street Fighters, Winter-Hardened, or Shell-Shocked and Battle-Weary. Every unit keeps a service record; the fallen go on the Roll of Honour. Win a campaign and your army marches in a victory parade.

BATTLE MODE
Raise a Battle Group for each side of the war, from any unit of the war, and take it into matches against other players. Your army always comes back, keeps what it learned, and earns titles, feats and honours. Choose your side and the weather, fight under fog of war, buy intelligence, and ask for a rematch.

MORALE AND THE FATE OF A UNIT
Units have morale: a surprise against the odds can shake a whole line. Trapped units starve and surrender, and closing a ring is a moment to remember. When a veteran's life hangs on one blow, the battle slows to watch; some cheat death, and a kill against long odds is celebrated as a Long Shot.

SUPPLY, SIEGES AND WEATHER
Supply runs along the roads and railheads you hold. Cut the enemy's lines and their units starve; surround a city and its defences crumble. Snow, mud and storms change how every kind of unit moves and fights, with a three-turn forecast.

BECOME THE COMMANDER
Rise from Major to Field Marshal over 20 levels. Attributes strengthen the whole army; Command Points buy 13 tactics, from an artillery barrage to an airlift. While the game is closed your commander studies the Field Manual or trains a unit of your Battle Group.

EVERY ATTACK SHOWS ITS MATHS
Before you commit, the forecast shows attack and defence, every modifier and the losses each side can expect. Watch the enemy's turn play out, with your general on the radio calling the big moments.

DAILY AND WEEKLY OPERATIONS
A new battle every day and every week, each with its own twist and a leaderboard showing the difficulty every score was earned on. Watch the leader's battle film, and share a film of your own.

FEATURES
• Three campaigns, 48 battles, branching roads through the war
• 126 illustrated unit types, from cavalry to jet fighters
• Battle Mode: your own army against other players, under fog of war
• Turn-based matches through Game Center, with chat and rematches
• Morale, 12 traits, nine medals, service records and the Roll of Honour
• Encirclement, supply lines, sieges, airlifts and weather by unit type
• Voiced briefings, histories and battlefield calls
• Training lessons, and How to Play with diagrams
• Battle films to watch and share
• Three difficulty levels, fog of war, Dynamic Type and colour-vision settings
• 25 Game Center achievements and six leaderboards
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets
• Battles play offline. No ads, no tracking.

apps.name: Parallax: Netrek
apps.description:
Parallax is a new way to play Netrek, the team space battle game that started on the Internet in 1989. Four teams fight for a galaxy of 40 planets: fly a ship, win dogfights, carry armies and take planets for your team.

LEARN IT HERE
Netrek has a reputation for being hard to learn. Parallax teaches it step by step. The tutorial walks you through your first flight with prompts for the device in your hands, then 15 training missions take you from orbiting your first planet to defending a starbase in a last stand.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Tutorial: learn the controls, then take your first flight.
• 15 missions: from first flight to last stand, with stars for flying well.
• Skirmish: a battle against robots that lasts as long as you like, with your choice of team, ship and difficulty.
• Play online: live games against people on the public Netrek servers, with the classic rules.

MADE FOR APPLE TV, IPAD AND MAC
• Fly with a game controller on every device. On Apple TV a controller is required.
• On iPad, play with on-screen controls or a controller.
• On Mac, use the keyboard and mouse or a controller. The Galactic Map and messages can open in their own windows.
• A quick menu on the controller puts lock, tractor beam and more under one button.

CLASSIC NETREK
Parallax speaks the classic protocol and plays on the same public servers as every other Netrek client, so you join the existing community. Six ship classes, the classic weapons (torpedoes, lasers and plasma) and the classic timings.

GAME CENTER
13 achievements to earn and two leaderboards.

Multiplayer is free to play, always. The tutorial and the first missions are free too. The Advanced and Expert missions are a one-time in-app purchase.

Parallax's protocol and networking code is open source.

apps.name: AQUARIUM PULU
apps.description:
Talk with PULU
and collect all kinds of PULU

◆How to Play
1 Talk with PULU
2 Give items to PULU
3 Watch PULU grow

Life with PULU, who lives in your aquarium.

Teach PULU words
and give it items.
As you spend time together,
PULU will grow little by little.

When PULU is fully grown,
its color and personality
will clearly show.

What kind of PULU will yours become?
You'll find out once it's grown.

PULU is reborn
again and again, journeying on.
Why not sit back and watch PULU grow at your own pace?

apps.name: Astrarium: Bullet Hell Shooter
apps.description:
Astrarium is a bullet hell space shooter you play with one thumb. You fly 100 levels through a night sky built like a great brass clock, take on 34 bosses, and turn the enemy's bullets into gold.

No energy, no waiting, no loot boxes, and nothing to buy that makes you stronger.

HOW IT PLAYS
• Drag to fly. Your ship flies above your thumb and moves further than your thumb does, so a short move takes it far. It fires by itself.
• Only the small bright core of your ship can be hit. Let bullets pass close: every one that crosses the gold ring around the core charges your Overdrive, your special attack.
• Fire the Overdrive and every bullet on the screen turns into gold.
• Lift your thumb and time stands still. Find the gap, then fly on.

100 LEVELS, 34 BOSSES
• 16 skies, each with its own enemies, its own music and its own tricks: darkness lit only by lanterns, curtains of sand with one wandering gap, meteors whose shadows show where they will fall.
• Every third level, a constellation boss of brass and pearls: Scorpius, Draco, Leo, Hercules, Gemini and more. Some are mazes of turning wheels and running chains that you fly through, because no shot can break them.
• At level 100 waits the Astrarium itself, the hardest fight in the game.

UPGRADES YOU PICK
After each level you pick one of three upgrades. 54 upgrades in six kinds change how you shoot, dodge, collect and survive, and three or five of one kind unlock bonus powers. Every 12 levels your upgrades start over, and you keep one of them for the rest of the game.

SIX SHIPS
Polaris, balanced. Vega, a wide fan of shots. Antares, slow and heavy. Sirius, with wings that hunt on their own. Altair, small and quick. Deneb, strongest up close. Unlock them with Starlight, the reward you earn in every level.

THE SUPERNOVA
Everything your Overdrive destroys lights one of eight lights around your ship. When all eight are lit, tap the power button and a ring of light sweeps across the whole screen. Or save it, and it blocks the next hit for you.

FROM RELAXED TO NEARLY IMPOSSIBLE
The first skies are for everyone. Then every 12 levels bring something new, and the last ten levels are made for shoot 'em up veterans: nearly impossible. Lose a level and you fly it again right there, with more shields every time. Want more time to react? Switch on the gentler pace.

MUSIC THAT PLAYS ALONG
Every sky has its own theme, sung by a choir. The music grows with your combo, and every piece of gold you collect plays a note in the key of the song.

FAIR BY DESIGN
• The whole game is free to play.
• Ads only when you choose to watch one for a reward, never during a level. For example: after a lost level, one ad gives you two shields so you can keep going.
• One optional purchase, Patron, to support us: you get every reward without watching an ad, plus a special aurora trail behind your ship.
• Plays offline.

ALSO
• Daily Flight: one short challenge a day, the same for everybody
• Over 50 small goals to earn
• Three bullet colours chosen with colour blindness in mind, a calm screen option (fewer flashes, no shaking) and automatic Overdrive
• Portrait, one hand, playable on a bus
• English and German

apps.name: Cats by Post
apps.description:
The parcels are purring. Best get them home.

Cats by Post is a cosy logic puzzle game about cats in boxes. Place turntables, work out a route and send the post. Your job is to get every cat to the right basket. Their job is to curl up in it.

Start with a few simple deliveries in the Sorting Office, then follow the post through a busy depot, aboard the mail train and into the Great Postal Vault. Gates change direction, paired tunnels open up new routes, and bigger cats take things at their own pace. That neat little plan might need another look.

There’s plenty to keep the sorting desk busy:
- 100 puzzles, with new twists as your postal round grows.
- Today’s Post: a fresh puzzle every day.
- Practice puzzles and Night Shift for when you fancy another delivery.
- Cat photographs to collect as you bring more cats home in Night Shift.
- Detailed paper-cutout rooms, small things to notice and music to keep you company.
Take your time over a tricky route. Try another arrangement. Then enjoy the moment when the last cat settles into its basket.

Precious cargo. Handle with care.

apps.name: Chibiwish
apps.description:
Meet Star: a tiny chibi girl with a cozy little room, a big appetite and a closet full of cute outfits.
Pat her, dress her up, cook her favorite dishes, dance together and fill your Wish Album, a few happy minutes at a time.
Every week brings a new costume board, with free spins you earn just by playing.

• DRESS HER UP
Open her closet and pick today's look. Collect outfits and find her new favorite dress.

• A NEW COSTUME EVERY WEEK
Each week a new themed board opens with a costume to win. Spins are free: you get one every day, earn more by caring for Star, or watch an optional video for extra spins. Spins are never sold, and the board shows the odds of every prize before you spin.

• COOK HER CRAVINGS
Star gets hungry just like you. When her tummy rumbles, she tells you which dish she is craving. Pick a recipe, let it cook and serve it warm. Learn new recipes as you go.

• FILL YOUR WISH ALBUM
Collect illustrated cards, chapter by chapter. Every card is earned by playing: finish daily goals and play the weekly board to open chests of cards, coins and gems. Cards are never sold.

• DANCE TOGETHER
Step into the dance room, pick a difficulty and tap in time with Star's moves.

• GO TO SCHOOL
Put on her school uniform and join a lesson at the chalkboard. Match the pairs and finish class with a smile.

• BUBBLY BATH TIME
When Star needs a wash, run her a bath and scrub her clean until she sparkles.

• MAKE HER ROOM YOURS
• Place furniture, rugs, plushies and lamps wherever you like
• Make over the walls and floors: pick a pattern, then a color
• Change the curtains and brighten up the kitchen

• WEATHER OUTSIDE HER WINDOW
Sunny days, falling leaves, snow and stormy nights. Her room shifts softly from morning light to bedtime.

• LITTLE WISHES, BIG FRIENDSHIP
Each day Star makes a few small wishes. Grant them, keep her happy and grow your friendship to unlock outfits and surprises.

• MADE FOR COZY BREAKS
Visit for a minute or stay a while. Nothing is lost while you are away. She is simply happy you came back.

GOOD TO KNOW
- Chibiwish is free to play. The game shows ads, including optional videos you can watch for a small reward.
- In-app purchases include gem packs, a one-time "Rewards without ads" unlock, and Star Club, a monthly subscription with most rewards without the video and gems every day. Star Club renews automatically until you cancel it in your Apple account settings.
- An internet connection is needed to play.
- Your game is saved on your phone and can be backed up to your own iCloud.
- Plays in English, Japanese, Korean, and Simplified and Traditional Chinese.

Terms of Use: https://ravideliyahu.com/chibiwish/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://ravideliyahu.com/chibiwish/privacy/

apps.name: Don't Touch the Water Game
apps.description:
A flooded kingdom. A missing princess. One very dangerous place to swim.

Leap between islands, explore branching paths, and find your way to safety in Don't Touch the Water. The water monster listens for every splash. On land, other creatures stand between you and your escape.

CHOOSE YOUR HERO
Find a character that fits your style, with different strengths and abilities.

MAKE EVERY JUMP COUNT
Cross moving platforms, reach checkpoints, and escape sinking ground before it disappears beneath your feet.

FIGHT FOR YOUR WAY OUT
Collect weapons, take on island monsters, and earn coins to unlock more characters.

FIND THE EXIT
Explore the islands, look for a key, and open the tunnel to safety.

apps.name: Dots and Boxes: LAST BOX
apps.description: One line can flip the whole board. Connect two dots, claim a square, and take another turn. Think one move ahead… or three. Take on three levels of AI, pass the same iPhone to a friend, or crack 15 free challenges. Send someone a code and see if they spot the move. The optional Extra Notebook adds 15 tougher puzzles and three paper styles. Play offline.

apps.name: NPL Cricket League
apps.description:
NPL Cricket League is online cricket made in Nepal. Make a lobby, bring your friends or let anyone join, and play a real match ball by ball.

PLAY ONLINE, YOUR WAY
• Blitz (2 overs) or Quick (5 overs) matches.
• Teams of 1 to 11 players a side.
• Private lobbies for a code or an invite, friends-only lobbies, or open lobbies anyone can join.
• Quick Join drops you into an open lobby with room, or browse the lobbies that are waiting.
• Captains call the toss, choose to bat or bowl and set the batting order.

BAT AND BOWL
• Time your shots and pick your gaps: leg side, off side or lofted.
• Bowl pace or swing, and drag on the pitch to choose your line and length.
• Every ball is decided on the server, so both sides see the same match.

PLAY WITH FRIENDS
• Add friends by username and see who is online.
• Invite friends straight into your lobby, with a notification if they are away.
• Quick chat, short messages, emotes and voice calls ("Run! Run!", "Howzat!", "What a shot!").
